plugin.name: Wbcom Designs – Infinite Loader for WooCommerce
plugin.description: AJAX-powered infinite scroll, Load More button, or AJAX pagination for WooCommerce shop archives. On a shop / category / tag / product-taxonomy archive the frontend script fetches the next archive page over AJAX (GET with infinite_loader_ajax=1), and the plugin answers with the product grid alone (not the whole page), appending it beneath the current products; a configurable loading icon (Font Awesome 5 Free) animates while it loads. Owner configures loading style, per-page count, icon, and button styling on a shared Wbcom settings screen.

rest.note: No REST API. The only server request is a public, unauthenticated read of the WooCommerce archive on template_redirect, keyed by the infinite_loader_ajax request flag — see public_read_endpoint below.

ajax_note: No admin-ajax.php (wp_ajax_) actions. wp_create_nonce('infinite_loader_ajax_nonce') is generated and localized to the frontend script but the read endpoint deliberately does not verify it — the request only renders a public archive and mutates nothing, and dropping the per-visitor nonce is what restores full-page-cache compatibility (WP Rocket / Varnish / Cloudflare). See public_read_endpoint.

public_read_endpoint.auth: unauthenticated by design (public archive, read-only, no state change; nonce dropped for page-cache compatibility)
public_read_endpoint.renderer: Infinite_Loader_For_Woocommerce_Admin::render_products_only (private) — emits result count + product loop (wc_get_template_part content/product) + pagination only, then exit; strips its own infinite_loader_ajax marker from the request/REQUEST_URI first so WooCommerce add-to-cart links do not inherit it
public_read_endpoint.full_page_fallback: apply_filters('infinite_loader_render_products_only', true) — return false to render the whole archive (pre-1.2.4 behaviour) for themes whose loop is built outside the standard WooCommerce loop templates

rate_limiter.client_ip: Infinite_Loader_For_Woocommerce::get_client_ip — walks CF-Connecting-IP / Client-IP / X-Forwarded-* / Forwarded / REMOTE_ADDR, validates each with FILTER_VALIDATE_IP (no private/reserved)

security_headers.scope: frontend WooCommerce archive pages (is_shop / is_product_category / is_product_tag / is_product_taxonomy)

admin_pages.title: WB Plugins
admin_pages.source: admin/class-infinite-loader-for-woocommerce-admin.php:244-258 register_parent_menu (only when no other Wbcom plugin already created it)

admin_pages.title: Infinite Loader (settings)
renders_tabs: overview (default) — read-only summary of how the shop currently loads products
general — loading style, products per load, Font Awesome toggle, loading-icon picker, spin toggle, do-not-update-URL toggle
javascript-css — custom CSS + before/after-update JS hooks
admin_pages.shell: Shared Wbcom_Settings_Page shell (lib/wbcom-settings/); this plugin contributes nav via filter infinite_loader_settings_nav_groups and tab bodies via action infinite_loader_settings_tab_content

settings.controls: product_loading_type (infinity-scroll | load-more-button | pagination), product_per_page (1-100), enable_font_awesome (yes|''), rotate_image (yes|''), do_not_update_url (yes|''), loading_image (Font Awesome class or image URL)
Load More button — custom_class, button_text, background_color / _mouse_hover, border_color, text_color / _mouse_hover, text_font_size, padding/margin/border/border-radius per side (0-999)
Previous button — same field set as the Load More button
custom_css (tags/@import/javascript: stripped), before_update / after_update (JS hooks; PHP + <script> + dangerous-pattern stripped)

object_cache: get_cached_option() wraps each option in wp_cache_get/set (default group, HOUR_IN_SECONDS) so the 4 option reads per archive request are not repeated DB hits

filters: infinite_loader_render_products_only (bool, default true) — products-only vs full-page response
infinite_loader_should_load_assets (bool) — which pages enqueue the frontend assets

infinite_loader_products_selector / _item_selector / _pagination_selector / _next_page_selector / _prev_page_selector / _result_count_selector — override the WooCommerce DOM selectors the script scrapes
infinite_loader_scroll_threshold (int px, default 300) — how close to list end infinite scroll triggers
infinite_loader_js_data (array) — the whole localized data object

js: public/js/infinite_loader_products.js (+ min/) — the loader engine: infinity-scroll / load-more / AJAX-pagination, next-page GET with infinite_loader_ajax=1, XHR abort on re-trigger, URL validation (is_valid_url), browser history.replaceState (address bar follows shopper), running result-count substitution, retry on error
css: public/css/infinite_loader_products.css (+ min/, rtl/) — loader / button / spinner styling
fonts: public/css/fontawesome5.min.css — Font Awesome 5 Free (bundled webfonts). Enqueued on the storefront only when the owner enables Font Awesome, and in wp-admin on the settings screen so the icon picker shows real icons. The sibling public/css/font-awesome.min.css is a FA5 Pro build whose fonts are NOT shipped and is intentionally never enqueued.
frontend_assets.load_condition: is_shop() || is_product_category() || is_product_tag() || is_product_taxonomy() (filterable via infinite_loader_should_load_assets)

js: admin/js/admin.js (+ min/) — icon-picker popup, colour pickers
admin_assets.deps: jquery, wp-color-picker; fontawesome5.min.css enqueued for the General-tab icon picker
admin_assets.removed: select2 no longer enqueued (a single 3-option dropdown became a native select; vendor files kept in repo)

shared_shell.loader: wbcom_settings_register('1.0.2', ...) — highest bundled version across active Wbcom plugins wins and renders the menu for all
shared_shell.icons: assets/vendor/lucide.min.js (Lucide, used by the shell nav)

security.public_read: Unauthenticated by design; read-only; changes no state. Security headers set on the response (nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, noindex/nofollow).
security.rate_limit: 30 req/min per IP on the read endpoint (filterable), 429 on breach.
security.archive_headers: X-XSS-Protection, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy on archive page loads.
security.css_sanitize: custom_css run through wp_strip_all_tags + @import / javascript: / expression() stripping at save AND via pre_update_option; NOT esc_html'd inside <style> (would break CSS combinators).
security.js_sanitize: before/after-update JS strips PHP tags, <script>, and a denylist of dangerous patterns (eval, new Function, document.write, innerHTML=, document.cookie, local/sessionStorage, window/document.location=, setTimeout/setInterval string form, execScript) at save.
security.colors: hex-only regex validation on every colour field.
security.uninstall: activate_plugins cap + check_admin_referer('delete-plugin'); multisite path uses get_sites().

primary_flows.owner: Plugins → WB Plugins → Infinite Loader → General: choose loading style (Load More / Infinite Scroll / AJAX pagination), set products per load, enable Font Awesome and pick a loading icon; Button Style / Previous Button Style tabs style the buttons; save. Overview tab summarises the live behaviour.
primary_flows.shopper: Open the shop archive on a supported page: scrolling near the end (infinite scroll) or clicking Load More fetches the next page via AJAX (GET infinite_loader_ajax=1), appends the product grid, updates the visible 'Showing X-Y of Z' count, and (unless the owner opted out) updates the address bar so Back returns them where they were.

static_analysis.notes: No REST, no cron, no custom tables, no shortcodes, no blocks, no WP-CLI — the plugin is a frontend loader over WooCommerce archives plus a settings screen. The single server entry point is the public read endpoint on template_redirect. No companion Free/Pro pair.
